value.answer: With a sibling who had strep, this could be strep, but a virus is just as possible, and only a throat swab can tell. A strep test isn't urgent, but it's worth having your doctor do one within 24 hours, before any antibiotics.
value.triage: Call 811 for nurse advice if she won't drink for over 8 hours, has a stiff neck, can't open her mouth fully, or has a fever over 40 C. Call 911 or go to the ER now for severe trouble breathing, new drooling with no swallowing, fainting, or purple spots.
